title: Command Inspection Program
summary: Command Inspectors General who conduct inspections under the Commanding General’s Inspection Program
applicabilityLevel: Command Inspectors General who conduct inspections under the Commanding General’s Inspection Program

source.title: IGMC Functional Area Checklist - Command Inspection Program
source.publisher: Inspector General of the Marine Corps

items.question: Is the command inspector billet a primary duty?
Has the command published a CGIP directive? Is the directive in compliance with higher headquarters directives?
Does the command inspector have a training program for augment inspectors?
Do augment inspectors have the technical expertise to inspect their functional area, i.e., are they qualified?
Does the command inspector inspect all the subordinate units at least every two years?
Does the command inspector, and all augment inspectors, use the functional area checklists maintained on the IGMC website as the basis for conducting inspections?
Does the commander's grading system comply with Marine Corps policy, i.e., Effective/Ineffective?
Has the command adopted a philosophy of short or no notice inspections similar to that of the IGMC in order to minimize wasted preparation time and to give commanders an accurate assessment?
Are the CoRE functional areas included in the CGIP?
Are inspectors making clear and useful annotations to each question on the checklist?
Are findings and discrepancies clearly noted on the checklist?
Is the Final Inspection Report (FIR) provided to the commander of the inspected unit within 30 days from the completion of the inspection?
Are recommendations contained in the FIR supported by references?
Does the FIR require action by the inspected unit to correct findings and Ineffective functional areas?
Does the command inspector maintain an effective system for monitoring and tracking actions taken to correct problem areas reported on FIR?

Does the IG maintain a copy of the FIR in accordance with records schedule 5040 of 6 years? (The checklists of the inspection need only to be retained for 2 years, and may be removed from the FIR thereafter)
